meta.source: 2024 rules (SRD 5.2) as filed for the player-channel card: weapon proficiencies, spell slots, level 1-2 class features with uses and recharge, species traits, origin feats, invocations, one-line spell mechanics. Read by tools/card_rules.py; numbers on the card are computed from each Crawler's class, level, scores, build and inventory, never typed. Syndicate/Book Author: check against the book like chargen-5e.json (verify list).
changelog: 0.2.0 (2026-10-07, Syndicate review): spellcasting.*.cantrips_by_level / prepared_by_level / always_prepared (Hunter's Mark, Divine Smite at 2, Speak with Animals), Wizard spellbook size, Warlock invocations_by_level; Monk Martial Arts 2024 wording; Magic Initiate picks shown.

rests.short_rest_note: spend Hit Dice: roll each + CON modifier, regain that many HP
rests.long_rest_note: saferoom only (core 5.6): all HP, all spent Hit Dice, long-rest uses

Barbarian.name: Rage
Barbarian.text: Bonus Action, lasts 10 min (extend each turn by attacking, forcing a save, or a Bonus Action): Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing; +{rage} damage on Strength attacks; Advantage on Strength checks and saves. No spells or Concentration; no Heavy armor.

Barbarian.name: Unarmored Defense
Barbarian.text: No armor: AC 10 + Dex + Con (shield allowed).

Barbarian.name: Danger Sense
Barbarian.text: Advantage on Dexterity saves unless Incapacitated.

Barbarian.name: Reckless Attack
Barbarian.text: On your first attack of a turn: Advantage on Strength attacks this turn; attacks against you have Advantage until your next turn.

Bard.name: Bardic Inspiration
Bard.text: Bonus Action, 60 ft: a creature gets a {bardic_die} to add to one failed d20 Test within the next hour.

Bard.name: Expertise
Bard.text: Double proficiency in two skills you are proficient in.

Bard.name: Jack of All Trades
Bard.text: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (+{half_pb}) to ability checks you are not proficient in.

options.Protector: Protector: Martial weapons and Heavy armor training.
options.Thaumaturge: Thaumaturge: one extra Cleric cantrip; add your Wis modifier (min +1) to Int (Arcana or Religion) checks.

Cleric.name: Channel Divinity
Cleric.text: Divine Spark (Magic action, 30 ft: heal or deal necrotic/radiant {cd_dice} + Wis, Con save for half) or Turn Undead (Wis save, Frightened and Incapacitated 1 min).

Druid.name: Druidic
Druid.text: You know the secret language of druids; Speak with Animals always prepared.

options.Magician: Magician: one extra Druid cantrip; add your Wis modifier (min +1) to Int (Arcana or Nature) checks.
options.Warden: Warden: Martial weapons and Medium armor training.

Druid.name: Wild Shape
Druid.text: Bonus Action: take a known Beast form for hours equal to half your Druid level; temp HP equal to your Druid level.

Druid.name: Wild Companion
Druid.text: Magic action: spend a spell slot or a Wild Shape use to cast Find Familiar without material components.

options.Archery: Archery: +2 to attack rolls with Ranged weapons (already in Attacks).
options.Defense: Defense: +1 AC while wearing armor (already in AC).
options.Dueling: Dueling: +2 damage with a one-handed melee weapon and no other weapon (already in Attacks).
options.Great Weapon Fighting: Great Weapon Fighting: treat a 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3 with Two-Handed or Versatile melee weapons held in two hands.
options.Interception: Interception: Reaction, reduce damage to an ally within 5 ft by 1d10 + PB (needs a shield or weapon).
options.Protection: Protection: Reaction, impose Disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 ft (needs a shield).
options.Thrown Weapon Fighting: Thrown Weapon Fighting: +2 damage with thrown weapons (already in Attacks); draw as part of the attack.
options.Two-Weapon Fighting: Two-Weapon Fighting: add your ability modifier to the damage of the extra Light-weapon attack.
options.Unarmed Fighting: Unarmed Fighting: Unarmed Strike 1d6 + Str (1d8 with both hands free); 1d4 to a creature you grapple at the start of your turn.

Fighter.name: Action Surge
Fighter.text: On your turn: take one extra action (not the Magic action).

Fighter.name: Tactical Mind
Fighter.text: When you fail an ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10 (kept if it still fails).

Monk.name: Martial Arts
Monk.text: Unarmed Strikes and Monk weapons (Simple melee, Martial melee with Light) can use Dex instead of Str and deal at least {ma_die}; one Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action each turn (no Attack action needed); Grapple/Shove DC can use Dex (numbers in Attacks).

Monk.name: Unarmored Defense
Monk.text: No armor or shield: AC 10 + Dex + Wis.

Monk.name: Focus Points
Monk.text: Flurry of Blows (1 FP: two Bonus Action Unarmed Strikes), Patient Defense (Disengage free; 1 FP: also Dodge), Step of the Wind (Dash free; 1 FP: also Disengage, jump x2). Save DC {ki_dc}.

Monk.name: Unarmored Movement
Monk.text: +10 ft Speed while unarmored and without a shield.

Monk.name: Uncanny Metabolism
Monk.text: When you roll Initiative: regain all Focus Points and heal {ma_die} + {level}.

Paladin.name: Lay on Hands
Paladin.text: Bonus Action, touch: restore HP from the pool, or spend 5 to remove the Poisoned condition.

Paladin.name: Fighting Style
Paladin.text: One Fighting Style feat (or Blessed Warrior: two Cleric cantrips).

Paladin.name: Paladin's Smite
Paladin.text: Divine Smite is always prepared; cast it once without a slot. Bonus Action after a melee hit: +2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot level, +1d8 vs Fiends/Undead).

Ranger.name: Favored Enemy
Ranger.text: Hunter's Mark is always prepared; cast it this many times without a spell slot.

Ranger.name: Deft Explorer
Ranger.text: Expertise in one skill; two extra languages.

Ranger.name: Fighting Style
Ranger.text: One Fighting Style feat (or Druidic Warrior: two Druid cantrips).

Rogue.name: Sneak Attack
Rogue.text: Once per turn: +{sneak} with a Finesse or Ranged weapon if you have Advantage, or an ally is within 5 ft of the target and you lack Disadvantage.

Rogue.name: Thieves' Cant
Rogue.text: Secret rogue language; one extra language.

Rogue.name: Cunning Action
Rogue.text: Bonus Action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

Sorcerer.name: Innate Sorcery
Sorcerer.text: Bonus Action, 1 min: +1 to your spell save DC and Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls.

Sorcerer.name: Font of Magic
Sorcerer.text: Sorcery Points: turn them into spell slots (Bonus Action) or spell slots into points.

Sorcerer.name: Metamagic
Sorcerer.text: Two Metamagic options to twist spells with Sorcery Points.

Warlock.name: Magical Cunning
Warlock.text: 1-minute rite: regain half your Pact Magic slots (round up).

Wizard.name: Ritual Adept
Wizard.text: Cast any Ritual spell in your spellbook as a Ritual without preparing it.

Wizard.name: Arcane Recovery
Wizard.text: After a Short Rest: recover spent spell slots with combined level up to {arcane_recovery}.

Wizard.name: Scholar
Wizard.text: Expertise in one of Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature or Religion.

invocations.Armor of Shadows: Cast Mage Armor on yourself at will without a spell slot.
invocations.Eldritch Mind: Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration.
invocations.Fiendish Vigor: Cast False Life on yourself without a slot; take the maximum temp HP (12).
invocations.Gaze of Two Minds: Bonus Action, touch a willing creature: perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn.
invocations.Lessons of the First Ones: Gain one Origin feat of your choice.
invocations.Misty Visions: Cast Silent Image at will without a spell slot.
invocations.Pact of the Blade: Bonus Action: conjure or bond a pact weapon; attack with Cha, deal necrotic, psychic or radiant if you like (in Attacks).
invocations.Pact of the Chain: Cast Find Familiar as a Magic action without a slot (special forms); it can attack with its Reaction when you Attack.
invocations.Pact of the Tome: Book of Shadows: three cantrips and two 1st-level Rituals, always prepared; it is your focus.
invocations.Devil's Sight: See normally in Dim Light and Darkness, magical or not, within 120 ft.
invocations.Mask of Many Faces: Cast Disguise Self at will without a spell slot.

Alert.text: Add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative (already in Initiative); swap Initiative with a willing ally.

Crafter.text: Three Artisan's Tools; 20% off nonmagical gear; craft faster.

Healer.text: Battle Medic: Utilize a Healer's Kit use, the creature spends a Hit Die and heals the roll + {pb}; reroll 1s on healing dice.

Lucky.text: Spend 1: Advantage on your d20 Test, or Disadvantage on an attack roll against you.

Magic Initiate (Cleric).text: Two Cleric cantrips and one level 1 Cleric spell; cast that spell once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Ability: {mi_ability}. {mi_spells}

Magic Initiate (Druid).text: Two Druid cantrips and one level 1 Druid spell; cast that spell once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Ability: {mi_ability}. {mi_spells}

Magic Initiate (Wizard).text: Two Wizard cantrips and one level 1 Wizard spell; cast that spell once per Long Rest without a slot (or with slots). Ability: {mi_ability}. {mi_spells}

Musician.text: Three instruments; after a Short or Long Rest, give Heroic Inspiration to up to {pb} allies who hear you play.

Savage Attacker.text: Once per turn on a weapon hit: roll the damage dice twice and use either roll.

Skilled.text: Proficiency in three skills or tools (already in your skills).

Tavern Brawler.text: Unarmed Strike 1d4 + Str (in Attacks), reroll 1s; improvised weapon proficiency; push 5 ft once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit.

Tough.text: +2 HP per level (already in your HP).

Dragonborn.name: Breath Weapon
Dragonborn.text: Replaces one attack: 15-ft cone or 30-ft line (in Attacks).

Dragonborn.name: Draconic Flight
Dragonborn.text: Bonus Action: fly speed equal to your Speed for 10 min.

Dwarf.name: Dwarven Resilience
Dwarf.text: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saves to avoid or end Poisoned.

Dwarf.name: Dwarven Toughness
Dwarf.text: +1 HP per level (already in your HP).

Dwarf.name: Stonecunning
Dwarf.text: Bonus Action: Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 min while on or touching stone.

Elf.name: Fey Ancestry
Elf.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Charmed.

Elf.name: Keen Senses
Elf.text: Proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival (already in your skills).

Elf.name: Trance
Elf.text: Finish a Long Rest in 4 hours; magic can't put you to sleep.

Gnome.name: Gnomish Cunning
Gnome.text: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves.

Goliath.name: Large Form
Goliath.text: Bonus Action: become Large for 10 min, Advantage on Strength checks, +10 ft Speed.

Goliath.name: Powerful Build
Goliath.text: Advantage on checks to end Grappled; count as one size larger for carrying.

Halfling.name: Brave
Halfling.text: Advantage on saves to avoid or end Frightened.

Halfling.name: Halfling Nimbleness
Halfling.text: Move through the space of any creature a size larger than you.

Halfling.name: Luck
Halfling.text: Reroll a 1 on a d20 Test (must use the new roll).

Halfling.name: Naturally Stealthy
Halfling.text: You can Hide when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.

Human.name: Resourceful
Human.text: Gain Heroic Inspiration when you finish a Long Rest (reroll any die once).

Human.name: Skillful
Human.text: One extra skill proficiency (already in your skills).

Orc.name: Adrenaline Rush
Orc.text: Bonus Action: Dash and gain {pb} temp HP.

Orc.name: Relentless Endurance
Orc.text: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead.

Drow.text: Drow: Darkvision 120 ft; you know Dancing Lights (Faerie Fire at 3, Darkness at 5).

High Elf.text: High Elf: you know Prestidigitation (swap it on a Long Rest; Detect Magic at 3, Misty Step at 5).

Wood Elf.text: Wood Elf: Speed 35 ft; you know Druidcraft (Longstrider at 3, Pass without Trace at 5).

Forest Gnome.text: Forest Gnome: you know Minor Illusion; Speak with Animals always prepared, cast it free {pb} times per Long Rest.

Rock Gnome.text: Rock Gnome: you know Mending and Prestidigitation; build tiny clockwork devices (10 min).

Goliath.Cloud: Cloud's Jaunt: Bonus Action, teleport 30 ft.
Goliath.Fire: Fire's Burn: on a hit, +1d10 fire.
Goliath.Frost: Frost's Chill: on a hit, +1d6 cold and Speed -10 ft.
Goliath.Hill: Hill's Tumble: on a hit, knock a Large or smaller target Prone.
Goliath.Stone: Stone's Endurance: Reaction, reduce damage taken by 1d12 + Con.
Goliath.Storm: Storm's Thunder: Reaction when damaged, 1d8 thunder to a creature within 60 ft.

Abyssal.text: Abyssal: Resistance to Poison; you know Poison Spray (Ray of Sickness at 3, Hold Person at 5).

Chthonic.text: Chthonic: Resistance to Necrotic; you know Chill Touch (False Life at 3, Ray of Enfeeblement at 5).

Infernal.text: Infernal: Resistance to Fire; you know Fire Bolt (Hellish Rebuke at 3, Darkness at 5).

Acid Splash.line: Action, 60 ft: 5-ft sphere, DC {dc} Dex save or {cd}d6 acid.

Blade Ward.line: Action, Concentration 1 min: attackers subtract 1d4 from attack rolls against you.

Chill Touch.line: Action, touch: {atk} to hit, {cd}d10 necrotic; the target can't regain HP until the end of your next turn.

attack.rider: target can't regain HP until the end of your next turn

Dancing Lights.line: Action, 120 ft, Concentration 1 min: up to four torch-like lights (dim 10 ft); Bonus Action to move them 60 ft.

Druidcraft.line: Action, 30 ft: tiny nature effects (predict weather, bloom a flower, a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame).

Eldritch Blast.line: Action, 120 ft: {atk} to hit per beam, 1d10 force each ({beams}).

Fire Bolt.line: Action, 120 ft: {atk} to hit, {cd}d10 fire; ignites unattended flammable objects.

Friends.line: Action, 10 ft, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Wis save or a creature is Charmed by you; it knows afterward.

Guidance.line: Action, touch, Concentration 1 min: a willing creature adds 1d4 to ability checks with one skill you choose.

Light.line: Action, touch, 1 hour: an object sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light 20 ft more.

Mage Hand.line: Action, 30 ft, 1 min: a spectral hand manipulates objects and carries up to 10 lb (Magic action to steer).

Mending.line: 1 minute, touch: repair one break or tear in an object.

Message.line: Action, 120 ft: whisper to a creature; only it hears and it can whisper back.

Minor Illusion.line: Action, 30 ft, 1 min: a sound or an image of an object (5-ft cube); Study vs DC {dc} sees through it.

Prestidigitation.line: Action, 10 ft, up to 1 hour: small harmless tricks (clean, chill, warm, flavor, a sensory effect, a tiny trinket).

Produce Flame.line: Bonus Action, 10 min: a flame in your hand (light 20 ft); Magic action to hurl it: {atk} to hit, 60 ft, {cd}d8 fire.

Ray of Frost.line: Action, 60 ft: {atk} to hit, {cd}d8 cold; the target's Speed drops 10 ft until your next turn.

attack.rider: Speed -10 ft until the start of your next turn

Resistance.line: Action, touch, Concentration 1 min: pick a damage type; once per turn the creature reduces that damage by 1d4.

Sacred Flame.line: Action, 60 ft: DC {dc} Dex save or {cd}d8 radiant; cover doesn't help.

Shillelagh.line: Bonus Action, 1 min: your club or quarterstaff attacks with your spellcasting ability ({atk} to hit), d8 damage die (d10 at 5, d12 at 11), Force if you like.

Shocking Grasp.line: Action, touch: {atk} to hit, {cd}d8 lightning; the target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

attack.rider: target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn

Spare the Dying.line: Action, 15 ft: a creature at 0 HP becomes Stable.

Starry Wisp.line: Action, 60 ft: {atk} to hit, {cd}d8 radiant; the target sheds dim light and can't be Invisible until your next turn ends.

attack.rider: target glows and can't benefit from Invisible until the end of your next turn

Thaumaturgy.line: Action, 30 ft, up to 1 min: minor wonders (booming voice, flickering flames, tremors, a slammed door, eye color).

Thorn Whip.line: Action, 30 ft: {atk} to hit, {cd}d6 piercing; pull a Large or smaller target 10 ft toward you.

attack.rider: pull a Large or smaller target 10 ft toward you

Thunderclap.line: Action: every creature within 5 ft of you makes a DC {dc} Con save or takes {cd}d6 thunder.

True Strike.line: Action: one weapon attack using your spellcasting ability ({atk} to hit, weapon damage + {mod}), radiant if you like (+1d6 radiant at level 5).

Vicious Mockery.line: Action, 60 ft: DC {dc} Wis save or {cd}d6 psychic and Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

attack.rider: Disadvantage on its next attack roll

Alarm.line: Ritual, 30 ft, 8 hours: ward a door, window or 20-ft cube; you get an audible or mental alarm when a creature enters.

Animal Friendship.line: Action, 30 ft, 24 hours: DC {dc} Wis save or a Beast is Charmed by you.

Armor of Agathys.line: Bonus Action, self, 1 hour: 5 temp HP; while they last, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage (+5 each per slot level).

Arms of Hadar.line: Action, 10 ft around you: DC {dc} Str save or 2d6 necrotic and no Reactions until its next turn (half on a success).

Bane.line: Action, 30 ft, Concentration 1 min: up to 3 creatures make DC {dc} Cha saves or subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saves.

Bless.line: Action, 30 ft, Concentration 1 min: up to 3 creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves.

Burning Hands.line: Action, 15-ft cone: DC {dc} Dex save, 3d6 fire (half on a success).

Charm Person.line: Action, 30 ft, 1 hour: DC {dc} Wis save (Advantage if you're fighting it) or a Humanoid is Charmed by you.

Chromatic Orb.line: Action, 90 ft: {atk} to hit, 3d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder; doubles on the d8s leap to another target.

Color Spray.line: Action, 15-ft cone: DC {dc} Con save or Blinded until the end of your next turn.

Command.line: Action, 60 ft: DC {dc} Wis save or the target obeys a one-word command (Approach, Drop, Flee, Grovel, Halt) on its next turn.

Compelled Duel.line: Bonus Action, 30 ft, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Wis save or Disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can't willingly move more than 30 ft away.

Comprehend Languages.line: Ritual, 1 hour: understand any spoken or written language.

Create or Destroy Water.line: Action, 30 ft: create or destroy up to 10 gallons of water (or a rain that puts out flames).

Detect Evil and Good.line: Action, Concentration 10 min: sense Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead within 30 ft.

Detect Magic.line: Ritual, Concentration 10 min: sense magic within 30 ft and see its aura.

Detect Poison and Disease.line: Ritual, Concentration 10 min: sense poisons, poisonous creatures and magical diseases within 30 ft.

Disguise Self.line: Action, 1 hour: change how you look; Study vs DC {dc} sees through it.

Dissonant Whispers.line: Action, 60 ft: DC {dc} Wis save or 3d6 psychic and it must use its Reaction to move away (half, no move, on a success).

Divine Favor.line: Bonus Action, 1 min: your weapon hits deal +1d4 radiant.

Ensnaring Strike.line: Bonus Action after a weapon hit, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Str save or Restrained and 1d6 piercing each turn.

Entangle.line: Action, 90 ft, Concentration 1 min: 20-ft square of Difficult Terrain; DC {dc} Str save or Restrained.

Expeditious Retreat.line: Bonus Action, Concentration 10 min: Dash now and as a Bonus Action each turn.

Faerie Fire.line: Action, 60 ft, 20-ft cube, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Dex save or outlined: attacks against it have Advantage, it can't be Invisible.

Feather Fall.line: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 ft falls: up to 5 creatures fall slowly and take no fall damage.

Find Familiar.line: Ritual, 1 hour: a spirit familiar; telepathic link within 100 ft; it can deliver your touch spells.

Fog Cloud.line: Action, 120 ft, Concentration 1 hour: a 20-ft-radius sphere of fog (Heavily Obscured).

Goodberry.line: Action: ten berries for 24 hours; each heals 1 HP and feeds a creature for a day.

Grease.line: Action, 60 ft, 10-ft square, 1 min: Difficult Terrain; DC {dc} Dex save or Prone.

Guiding Bolt.line: Action, 120 ft: {atk} to hit, 4d6 radiant; the next attack roll against the target before your next turn ends has Advantage.

Hail of Thorns.line: Bonus Action after a Ranged weapon hit: the target and creatures within 5 ft make DC {dc} Dex saves, 1d10 piercing (half on a success).

Hellish Rebuke.line: Reaction when a creature within 60 ft damages you: DC {dc} Dex save, 2d10 fire (half on a success).

Heroism.line: Action, touch, Concentration 1 min: immune to Frightened; gains {mod} temp HP at the start of each of its turns.

Hex.line: Bonus Action, 90 ft, Concentration 1 hour: +1d6 necrotic when you hit the target; Disadvantage on checks with one ability you pick.

Hunter's Mark.line: Bonus Action, 90 ft, Concentration 1 hour: +1d6 force when you hit the target; Advantage on Perception/Survival checks to find it.

Ice Knife.line: Action, 60 ft: {atk} to hit, 1d10 piercing; hit or miss, it bursts: DC {dc} Dex save or 2d6 cold to the target and creatures within 5 ft.

Identify.line: Ritual, touch: learn a magic item's properties and how to use it.

Illusory Script.line: Ritual, 10 days: writing only creatures you choose can read.

Inflict Wounds.line: Action, touch: DC {dc} Con save, 2d10 necrotic (half on a success).

Jump.line: Bonus Action, touch, 1 min: once per turn the creature can jump 30 ft for 10 ft of movement.

Mage Armor.line: Action, touch, 8 hours: a creature without armor has base AC 13 + Dex.

Magic Missile.line: Action, 120 ft: three darts, each hits automatically for 1d4 + 1 force (+1 dart per slot level).

Protection from Evil and Good.line: Action, touch, Concentration 10 min: Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends and Undead have Disadvantage against it and can't Charm, Frighten or possess it.

Purify Food and Drink.line: Ritual, 10 ft: food and drink in a 5-ft sphere is safe from poison and rot.

Ray of Sickness.line: Action, 60 ft: {atk} to hit, 2d8 poison and Poisoned until the end of your next turn.

Sanctuary.line: Bonus Action, 30 ft, 1 min: an attacker must pass a DC {dc} Wis save or pick another target; ends if the warded creature attacks or harms.

Searing Smite.line: Bonus Action after a melee hit, 1 min: +1d6 fire, then 1d6 fire at the start of each of its turns until a Con save (DC {dc}).

Shield.line: Reaction when hit by an attack or targeted by Magic Missile: +5 AC until the start of your next turn (including against the trigger); no damage from Magic Missile.

Shield of Faith.line: Bonus Action, 60 ft, Concentration 10 min: +2 AC.

Silent Image.line: Action, 60 ft, Concentration 10 min: a silent visual illusion up to a 15-ft cube; Study vs DC {dc}.

Sleep.line: Action, 60 ft, 5-ft sphere, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Wis save or Incapacitated, then a second failed save means Unconscious.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.line: Action, 30 ft, Concentration 1 min: DC {dc} Wis save or Prone and Incapacitated, laughing (saves again each turn and when damaged).

Tenser's Floating Disk.line: Ritual, 30 ft, 1 hour: a floating disk carries up to 500 lb and follows you.

Thunderous Smite.line: Bonus Action after a melee hit: +2d6 thunder; DC {dc} Str save or pushed 10 ft and Prone.

Thunderwave.line: Action, 15-ft cube from you: DC {dc} Con save, 2d8 thunder and pushed 10 ft (half, no push, on a success).

Unseen Servant.line: Ritual, 60 ft, 1 hour: an invisible force does simple chores.

Witch Bolt.line: Action, 60 ft, Concentration 1 min: {atk} to hit, 2d12 lightning; on later turns a Bonus Action deals 1d12 lightning to it automatically.

Wrathful Smite.line: Bonus Action after a melee hit: +1d6 necrotic; DC {dc} Wis save or Frightened for 1 min (save each turn).

Divine Smite.line: Bonus Action after a melee hit: +2d8 radiant (+1d8 per slot level, +1d8 vs Fiends and Undead).
